【Product Overview】
A standout piece from the Supreme Week 1 collection, this Hooded Work Jacket masterfully merges the utilitarian roots of classic workwear with the high-visibility aesthetics of street culture. Constructed from tough full denim and insulated with quilted padding and a soft flannel plaid lining, it features bold 3M® reflective branding to ensure you stay warm and seen on the autumn and winter streets. The unisex, regular-fit silhouette is a must-have for building a high-impact urban look.

【Key Features】

  • Full Denim Construction: Built entirely from quality denim, offering durability and a unique washed vintage feel. The fabric provides a structured, iconic silhouette.

  • Functional Workwear Details:

    • Ample Storage: Two large front patch pockets and an internal chest pocket cater to your daily carry essentials.

    • Weather Defense: The ribbed knit cuffs and hem help seal out the wind. Quilted construction with cotton insulation and a flannel lining retains heat for cooler days.

  • Comfortable Lining & Fit: The soft flannel plaid interior ensures comfort against the skin. The regular workwear cut allows for easy layering and freedom of movement.

【Color & Size】

  • Sizes: S, M, L, XL

clothing.name: MONCLER Paneled Stand Collar Puffer Jacket | Knitted Cable Sleeves | Luxury Winter Style Redefined
clothing.nameEn: Expertly blending quilted fabric with knitted cable sleeves, this jacket features iconic details and a sharp silhouette for elevated winter styling in any setting.
clothing.description:
【Product Overview】
Where MONCLER's luxury DNA meets the innovative fusion of knitting and quilted fabric, this stand collar jacket emerges as the ultimate "Ace of Texture" for your fall and winter wardrobe. Transcending the boundaries of a traditional puffer, it strikes a perfect balance between robust warmth and high-fashion through masterful material contrast and meticulous detailing, redefining your winter style with effortless sophistication for any occasion.

【Key Features】

  • Innovative Paneled Design: The soul of this piece lies in the masterful blend of a quilted main body and intricately knitted cable sleeves. Signature black-and-white stripes and a branded arm patch subtly proclaim its iconic heritage and refined aesthetics.

  • Dual Luxury Textures:

    • The Warmth Zone: The quilted torso effectively traps body heat, providing confident protection against cold winds and winter chills.

    • The Comfort Zone: The raised cable-knit sleeves offer a supremely soft feel against the skin while providing greater freedom of movement and unique visual texture.

  • Sharp & Structured Silhouette: The sturdy stand-up collar not only shields against the wind but also frames the neckline for a clean, sharp look. The overall cut prioritizes both insulation and style, effectively avoiding winter bulk.

  • Boundless Styling Versatility: Its strong stylistic adaptability allows it to excel in various settings. Layer it over a dress shirt for urban polish, or pair it with a hoodie for instant street-ready flair. One jacket is all you need for all-day style, from daily commutes to casual outings.

【Color & Size】

  • Color: Black

  • Sizes: M, L, XL

clothing.name: KAILAS Ultralight Primaloft® Hooded Jacket | Quilted Construction | Helmet-Compatible Outdoor Insulated Layer
clothing.nameEn: Lightweight warmth for cold climates. Filled with high-efficiency Primaloft® insulation, featuring articulated cuffs and functional pockets, designed for active outdoor pursuits.
clothing.description:
【Product Overview】
The KAILAS Ultralight Hooded Jacket is engineered for outdoor enthusiasts who prioritize warmth without the weight. Its classic quilted "baffle" construction, filled with high-performance Primaloft® insulation, delivers reliable warmth with exceptional lightweight packability. Perfect as a versatile mid-layer for mountain hikes or a standalone jacket for urban commutes.

【Key Features】

  • Ultralight Primaloft® Insulation: Filled with renowned Primaloft® synthetic insulation, known for retaining heat even when damp. It provides outstanding warmth for its weight, ensuring comfort in cold climates.

  • Technical Outdoor Design:

    • Helmet-Compatible Hood: The elasticated hood is designed to fit over a climbing helmet, offering protection when the weather turns.

    • Articulated Gusseted Cuffs: The ergonomic "horseshoe" sleeve design allows for a greater range of motion and prevents ride-up during activity while sealing in warmth.

    • Secure Storage: Two zippered hand pockets safely store your essentials for easy access on the trail.

  • Clean Aesthetics: The classic quilted pattern is accented with a subtle chest print, blending technical performance with a style that transitions seamlessly from the trail to the city.

【Sizing Guide (Based on Weight)】

  • Size L: Recommended for 55-68 kg 

  • Size XL: Recommended for 68-78 kg 

  • Size XXL: Recommended for 78-85 kg 

  • Size 3XL: Recommended for 85-95 kg 

  • Size 4XL: Recommended for 95-105 kg

clothing.name: KAILAS AC133 Aerogel Insulated Jacket | Smart Temperature Regulation | Wind & Water Resistant | Unisex Outdoor Hiking Hoodie
clothing.nameEn: Featuring Aerogel & Volcanic Rock insulation for lightweight warmth and breathability. Wear alone or as a mid-layer, ideal for hiking, skiing, and commutes in temperatures as low as -20°C.
clothing.description:
【Product Overview】
The KAILAS AC133 redefines outdoor insulation with its advanced technology. It innovatively uses aerospace-grade materials like Aerogel and Volcanic Rock as filling, coupled with smart temperature-regulating technology that dynamically adjusts to "expand when cold, contract when hot." Whether worn as a standalone jacket for urban commutes or as a mid-layer under a shell for alpine skiing and mountaineering, it provides lightweight, consistent, and sleek warmth in extreme cold as low as -15°C to -20°C.

【Key Features】

  • Aerogel Insulation: The core is filled with Aerogel, known as "solid smoke," which boasts an extremely low thermal conductivity for superior heat retention that outperforms conventional materials, offering maximum warmth with minimal weight.

  • Versatile All-Rounder: With wind and water resistance, it performs excellently as a standalone jacket for daily wear and light hiking, or as a technical mid-layer under a hardshell for demanding activities like mountaineering and skiing.

  • Comfort & Practicality: Features a slim-fit cut to avoid bulkiness and a protective hood. The fabric is also treated with anti-odor technology for long-lasting freshness.

【Color & Size】

  • Colors: Black / Grey

  • Sizes: S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL

clothing.name: Adidas ZPONGE Hive Cushion Running Shoes | Stability & Sweat-Wicking | Rebound & Grip Men Women Trainers
clothing.nameEn: Inspired by Honeycomb Structure! Exclusive ZPONGE hive midsole delivers dynamic cushioning & powerful rebound. Paired with a sweat-wicking upper for a stable, dry run.
clothing.description:
(一) Bionic Technology, Propels the Future
The Adidas ZPONGE running shoes redefine performance with cutting-edge bionics. Its core hive-style midsole structure, inspired by nature, elevates efficient cushioning and energy return to a new level, designed for runners who seek stability, comfort, and superior performance.

(二) Technology Deconstructed

  • ZPONGE Hive Midsole: The midsole utilizes a unique hexagonal geometry. This bionic design effectively disperses impact upon landing and offers immediate, responsive energy rebound, giving you a powerful push-off with every step.

  • Grip & Durability Outsole: The outsole incorporates a honeycomb or multi-directional tread pattern made from high-abrasion rubber, ensuring reliable and long-lasting traction on various surfaces.

  • Dynamic Adaptability: The deformable nature of the hive structure allows the midsole to dynamically adapt to your stride, offering a stable support experience whether you're an overpronator, underpronator, or neutral runner.

clothing.name: Adidas Yeezy 450 'Cloud' Knit Sock Sneakers | Kanye West Justin Bieber Worn | Unique Podular Sole
clothing.nameEn: Dubbed the "Alien" Sneaker! Features a one-piece knit sock construction and a radical podular outsole for a futuristic look and a uniquely comfortable, form-fitting feel.
clothing.description:
(一) Redefining the Future of Footwear
The Adidas Yeezy 450 "Cloud" stands as one of the most radical designs from Kanye West's Yeezy lineage. With its futuristic knit sock-like upper and signature podular outsole, it shatters conventional sneaker aesthetics, earning its "Alien" nickname worldwide. Worn by style icons like Justin Bieber, it's the ultimate statement piece for those who dare to be different.

(二) Design Deconstructed

  • One-Piece Knit Sock Construction: A seamless, elastic knit upper wraps your foot like a second skin, offering a supremely adaptive fit and easy on-and-off wear.

  • Radical Podular Sole Unit: The heart and soul of the design. The midsole and outsole merge into one, featuring an upward-wrapping, pod-like structure that delivers an avant-garde look and uniquely supportive comfort.

  • Minimalist "Cloud" Colorway: The iconic light tone highlights the shoe's intricate textures and complex silhouette, making it a versatile centerpiece for any avant-garde wardrobe.

clothing.name: Adidas Campus 00s Vintage Color Blocking Suede Retro Platform Sneakers | Unisex Lifestyle Shoes
clothing.nameEn: Xiaohongshu Hot Trend! Born from the 00s archives, featuring a premium suede upper and elevated platform for a perfect blend of vintage style and all-day comfort.
clothing.description:
(一) Retro Reborn, Always in Style
The Adidas Campus 00s makes a triumphant return from the Y2K fashion archives! More than just a sneaker, it's a piece of retro culture. With its iconic color-blocking and premium suede construction, it has quickly become a viral sensation on Xiaohongshu, essential for crafting an effortless vintage casual look.

(二) Crafted Details, Premium Quality

  • Elevated Comfort Platform: Features a heightened midsole compared to the original, providing enhanced cushioning, a flattering silhouette lift, and all-day comfort.

  • Iconic Campus Silhouette: Stays true to the clean, low-profile look of the Campus lineage, with vintage color-blocking that instantly channels early 2000s vibes.

  • Ultimate Versatility: Easily pairs with everything from wide-leg jeans and cargo pants to casual dresses, making it a versatile cornerstone for your wardrobe.

clothing.name: Air Jordan 1 Low Travis Scott Reverse Mocha Swoosh Retro Low-Top Sneakers Basketball Shoes
clothing.nameEn: Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low Collaboration | Featuring the Iconic Reverse Swoosh | Crafted with Mocha Brown & Black-White Leather for a Redefined Streetwear Icon.
clothing.description:
(一) Overview & Story
More than just a sneaker, this is a streetwear revolution sparked by the collaboration between top rapper Travis Scott and Jordan Brand. The Air Jordan 1 Low "Reverse Mocha" defies convention with its daring Reverse Swoosh design, establishing itself as a must-have grail for every hypebeast. It perfectly merges the iconic Jordan DNA with the distinct aesthetics of "Cactus Jack," ensuring you stand out wherever you go.

(二) Key Features & Design Details

  • Iconic Reverse Swoosh: The standout feature! The classic Swoosh logo is reversed and prominently placed on the lateral side in a striking Mocha brown, breaking all the rules.

  • Premium Leather Upper: Constructed with a mix of premium suede and smooth leather in Mocha, Black, and Sail color blocks, offering rich texture and a luxurious feel.

  • Low-Top Comfort: The low-cut silhouette provides unparalleled flexibility and comfort for all-day wear, making it easy to style and perfect for various occasions.

The MACH 6 isn’t just a shoe – it’s a biomechanical manifesto. Here’s how NASA-grade tech meets Y2K rebellion:

⚠️ Pro Tip: Wide feet? Go half size up. Narrow feet? True to size hugs like a race glove.

This ​​feminine​​ fragrance opens with a ​​sparkling burst of mandarin and peach​​, unfolding into a ​​heart of jasmine, magnolia, and rose​​. The ​​base of vanilla, vetiver, and sandalwood​​ creates an ​​4-6 hour trail​​—a scent that is ​​both luminous and sophisticated​​.

  • ​​Top Notes:​​ Mandarin, Peach, Bergamot

Cambodian oud petrifies into stardust🌑 through meditation, while sandalwood etches ripples in Zen gardens🎋. Musks float like Dunhuang fresco ribbons🎨, binding timeless fragrance fossils in the museum of memory⏳.
